answer: A sybil farm must fund every fake identity with real stake and real work, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand times the deposit plus forfeited bonds when challenges fail. Participants stake an umber-bonded deposit at the wharf registry before joining the economy, and each identity must survive a random gale of peer challenges over several epochs. Honest agents recover their deposit, while attackers lose everything, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
